issues.failure_explanation: Conditional projection onto constants and ΔW generally leaves a nonzero orthogonal martingale residual. Consequently, the DBDP pathwise loss generally has a positive irreducible minimum; zero loss is not a valid general accuracy criterion.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Define the discretization by its conditional equations, or add the missing orthogonal martingale increment to the pathwise equation. Replace the zero-loss assertion by an excess-loss or projection-error interpretation.
